bastion-academy.text: Bastion Spire Academy Annex in the Core — vaulted Fleet training spaces built into the larger Bastion Spire complex, combining old memorial architecture with modern simulators, navigation labs and observation galleries.

mirrorfold.text: The Mirrorfold in the Lattice — fragile anomaly corridors where geometry folds into reflective chambers. Mirror Stars shimmer without heat; Veil Auroras refract through repeating planes; ships, faces, beacons and corridors can appear in multiple places; sound and sensor returns may echo along more than one path. Expeditions stage through Glass Horizon Survey Docks and stabilized calm eddies.
